oneOp: One op per call, as the only key: {"<op>": {...}}.
game_check: Facts on this game's running build. {oneOp} No op: look. look: the page as a player opens it, then a moment of play: errors with file:line, frame rate, both frames (play beside the reference picture). final: the full check Kurambit also runs on each build after your turn: also the scene report, the QA play (its problems are bugs) and a status line.
game_play: Drive the running game. {oneOp} act: input batches, each answered with the probe and a frame path; with no sessionId it opens a session. close: ends it. eval: JavaScript in the playing page, its JSON value back. bot: a .studio/bot/ file played to its end; its run is a play by one id. replay: saved test plays every build replays; save names a run; run, at: a run at a second, as an image. model_sheet: named models from six sides, with size and cost.
game_assets: Art, sound and the look. {oneOp} search: the open library, as a contact sheet; add: files, credited. lock: STYLE.json for made things. pictures: HTML or SVG per data row, as sheets. A refusal says what is missing: tell the person.
game_blender: This game's managed Blender: a live scene, saved as the game's .blend after each change. {oneOp} code: runs bpy Python, printing what you need. look: the scene as an image; mode review renders the model export would write. export: the objects as a GLB with its sidecar and what it measured. character: a rigged humanoid on the standard skeleton, sized. paint: textures from a turnaround sheet. animate: keys a move from poses on beats. asset_search, asset_import: Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Poly Pizza or library assets into the scene; a Poly Haven texture with applyTo goes under those parts' own materials. addon: installs a listed add-on once the person agrees. How: studio-skills/art-pipeline.md.
game_builds: Builds and undo. {oneOp} No op: list. list: builds, newest first; build: one, with what the harness measured on it. undo: takes a build out, later ones kept; to: goes back to it instead; only when the person asks. export: the Web release; zip: also a ZIP.
game_keep_going: Keep going, only when the person asks. No input: what it is doing. mode: off, guided or autopilot; budgetMinutes (null for none) on start or resume; steer: the person's words for its next step. A message starting "Keep going · step N" is a step: do that one change.
game_copy: This chat's copy of the game, work not in the game yet. {oneOp} copies: the game's copies and this chat's place. bring_in: your copy, or a child chat's, into the game. update: the game's newer builds into your copy.
